prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for adoption redesigns, as only one test has been completed so far.
Evidence is still thin for home new screens, as only one test has been completed so far.
Evidence is still thin for finish redesigns, as only one test has been completed so far.
No clear effect has been seen for adoption new screens across 2 completed tests.
Predictions have been consistently too high compared to noise-corrected measured results.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: -1.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: +2.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, redesign: -4.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_screen: -6.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 66.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.4%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Intro Carousel Redesign: Redesign the story screen into an interactive carousel layout highlighting different pet personalities before path selection. (why: choose_path step has a high mean duration of 514s and 23.8% drop-off; a carousel layout engages users early.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Personality Quiz Screen: Insert a short personality quiz screen before pick_friend to guide users toward their ideal companion choice. (why: Adoption has a 33.8% drop-off rate and a high median time of 89s; guiding preference selection improves decision speed and fit.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Sign In After Photo Upload Reorder: Move sign_in to occur after photo upload, right before the adoption certificate is finalized. (why: Sign-in drop-off is 27.1%; deferring sign-in until after pet customization builds ownership and increases completion.)
3: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Spotlight Redesign: Redesign home_intro with a spotlight layout highlighting key desktop control locations and shortcuts. (why: 3 support tickets reported confusion on how to control or hide pets, and finish step completion is only 64.8%.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Account Persistence Sign In Hint: Add an explicit hint on the sign-in screen assuring users that logging in restores their existing pets and data. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again.)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Visibility Status Info: Display real-time desktop overlay status indicators and system tray instructions during the waiting screen. (why: Support received 3 bug reports about pets failing to display on desktop, and home mean time is 2336s.)
6: [adoption, layout] Pick Friend Two Column Layout: Reformat the pick_friend screen layout to a two-column grid separating standard presets from custom photo generation. (why: 3 support tickets cited custom pet creation confusion/failures, and adoption has a 33.8% drop-off.)
7: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Lighting Guidance Hint: Add a visual photo quality hint explaining clear lighting and background rules for custom pet generation. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or distorted results.)

scores.note: Addresses high step duration, but lack of support mail and high cost lower priority.
High drop-off step, but adoption new screens have shown no positive effect (-1.1% historical).
Reordering sign-in reduces friction, though evidence is based solely on funnel drop-off.
Strong evidence from tickets and drop-off, but finish redesigns previously performed poorly (-4.0%).
High evidence from 8 support emails, simple low-cost copy change with high probability of success.
Targeted status info helps with desktop visibility bugs at low implementation cost.
Addresses major adoption drop-off and support confusion, though redesign evidence remains thin.
Cheap visual hint directly targeting 3 support emails on photo upload failures in high drop-off step.
